people.name: Hannah Philpot
people.role: FOCUS Missionary, Katholische Hochschulgemeinde Wien (University of Vienna)
people.fit_reason: Tier A; FOCUS missionaries in Austria are the same support-raised cohort. Found only by retrying Austria IN GERMAN, which did break the wall the English wave-l queries hit. Two caveats, both logged in needs_review: (a) the roster claims no year and the Vienna FOCUS partnership dates from 2016, so this may be an older cohort; (b) the German-language result set returned two Archdiocese of Vienna pages about the same team and the name may sit on the sibling page https://www.erzdioezese-wien.at/focusmissionare or on https://www.khg.wien/ueber-uns/focus-team - graded medium accordingly. No stage-2 upgrade: a batched focus.org query returned no person page for her.

people.name: Devon Kathol
people.role: FOCUS Team Leader, Katholische Hochschulgemeinde Wien (University of Vienna)

Same two caveats: unstated roster year (Vienna FOCUS began 2016, so possibly an older cohort) and ambiguity between the two Archdiocese of Vienna pages returned together - hence medium, not high. needs_review.issue: First-name-only rosters - the dominant failure mode on this axis, confirmed repeatedly in the West
needs_review.finding: UC Berkeley (calnewman.org) publishes its FOCUS team as 'Josh, Jency, Rhianna, Henry'. Saint John XXIII / Ram Catholic (Colorado State) states outright on its FOCUS page that it will place students' and missionaries' FIRST NAMES there. QUB Catholic (Belfast) names a sixth-year FOCUS missionary as 'Cassandra' only.
needs_review.recommendation: Do not emit and do not attempt to pair these first names with surnames from focus.org - that is invention. These pages are only usable if a future wave can fetch them directly (a rendered roster may carry surnames the snippet drops). Search alone will not resolve them.

needs_review.issue: Name inferred from an email address, not from printed text - deliberately NOT emitted
needs_review.finding: The UCLA University Catholic Center FOCUS roster snippet renders as 'FOCUS Missionary ana.kwan@focus.org - Perla Rodriguez'. A missionary named Ana Kwan is strongly implied by the focus.org first.last mailbox, but her name is not printed in anything I saw.
needs_review.recommendation: Verify by fetching the UCLA page or by a targeted focus.org/missionaries/ana-kwan check. Do not ingest on the email alone.

needs_review.issue: Citation-page ambiguity for the two Vienna records
needs_review.finding: The German query returned two Archdiocese of Vienna pages about the same KHG Wien FOCUS team plus two KHG Wien roster pages, and the bios for Hannah Philpot and Devon Kathol could sit on any of them. I cited the news article that best matches the biographical framing.
needs_review.recommendation: Re-point the source_url once one of these pages can be fetched. Both records are graded medium for exactly this reason.

needs_review.issue: Possible stale roster - Vienna cohort year unstated
needs_review.finding: Vienna and Graz received their first four-person FOCUS teams in autumn 2016 at the invitation of Cardinal Schoenborn and Bishop Krautwaschl. The Vienna bios I captured state no academic year, and one companion article describes 'three years of work' by the team, which would put it around 2019.
needs_review.recommendation: Treat Hannah Philpot and Devon Kathol as possibly-former missionaries pending a current KHG Wien roster. Neither has a focus.org person page today, which is consistent with departure.

needs_review.issue: Campus assignment conflict on a confirmed couple
needs_review.finding: uacatholic.org/focus (University of Arizona) names Mitchell and Clare Stephens as third-year missionaries on the UArizona Newman team, but their focus.org page places them as Parish Missionaries at Mother of Perpetual Help, Maryville, Illinois.
needs_review.recommendation: Ingest the two people (the focus.org page is unambiguous) but do not ingest the UArizona campus tag. The UArizona roster states no year and is likely stale.

needs_review.issue: Unnamed international teams confirmed to exist - a target list, not records
needs_review.finding: Four FOCUS missionaries are confirmed present at KHG Graz (Universitaet Graz), a team of four-to-five at UCC Cork via the Diocese of Cork and Ross, and a team at Queen's University Belfast. None are named in any snippet. No FOCUS roster surfaced for St. Poelten, University College Dublin, Maynooth or Southampton at all.
needs_review.recommendation: These are page-fetch targets, not further search targets. Note for the record: none of these are sensitive-region or anonymized cases - the names are simply absent from the index, so the sensitive-region rule does not apply and no anonymized worker was encountered anywhere in this slice.

needs_review.issue: Non-missionaries encountered on roster pages and correctly excluded
needs_review.finding: MMag. Alois Koelbl is listed as chaplain (Hochschulseelsorger) at KHG Graz alongside the FOCUS team; the Diocese of Cork and Ross article centres on Bishop Fintan Gavin welcoming the team. Neither is a FOCUS missionary.
needs_review.recommendation: No action - logged so a future wave does not re-harvest chaplains and bishops as missionaries.
